value.rationale: The natural F4 long/short two-orbit hull is a one-parameter deformation of mutually dual regular 24-cells, whose four-simplex volume and equality classification are canonical approximation invariants. The exact transition, strict mixed gap, 48/96 phase multiplicities, and three orbits of pure short extremizers give substantive information that the 24-cell problem alone cannot supply. The value is a complete natural family rather than a marginal numerical improvement or an artificially chosen parameter slice.
